notes: Stored edit of based_on (subproperty of derivative_of, chain based_on ∘ derivative_of ⊑ derivative_of). Since 2026-10-31 the record states what the encoding needs: 'No Linux distribution is derived from both Arch Linux and Debian' (a bridge, firm arch_debian_exclusive; it gives the original 'no' answers and w2's AUR 'no'), 'Arch Linux uses the pacman package manager' (a bridge; w2's original answer), and w2's reading of its stored belief as 'its base's community repository and no other's' (w2's assumes; the third w2 rule). The earlier firm 'one base per distribution' rule is dropped: no query needs it. Package manager and AUR access are stored by name (w1) or through the base (w2: rules over based_on).

background.arch_debian_exclusive: Thing ⊑ not (derivative_of value arch) or not (derivative_of value debian)
